links.surface: أبو محمد جعفر بن علي بن أحمد الفقيه
أبو محمد الحسن بن محمد بن علي بن صدقة القمي
أبو عمرو محمد بن عمر بن عبد العزيز الأنصاري الكجي

notes: «رضي الله عنه» after the first name is a blessing, not part of the surface
«حدثني من سمع الحسن بن محمد النوفلي يقول» : «من سمع» is an unnamed transmitter, then al-Nawfali, then the Imam al-Rida who speaks in the story (owner ruling 5, narrated encounter)
Sulayman al-Marwazi, al-Ma'mun and Imran speak inside the story too; they are scene characters, not the last link. The Imam is written as the text names him, not completed

notes: «أخبرني من سمع» is a gap: unnamed (rule 8); the report is Nawfali's account, so he is the link after it
Al-Rida speaks inside the story (the debate with Sulayman): last link (owner ruling 5)
the Imam's own quotations («رويت عن أبي عبد الله»; «أخبرني أبي عن آبائه») sit inside the saying: not stored as links
«رضي الله عنه» and «رحمه» are honorifics: left out
